description: NaYTiNbO₆F crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. Na is bonded to six O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent YO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.58 Å) and four longer (2.68 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.25 Å. Y is bonded to six O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted YO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent YO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.46 Å) and two longer (2.58 Å) Y-O bond lengths. Both Y-F bond lengths are 2.24 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent YO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-49°. There are two shorter (1.96 Å) and four longer (1.98 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent YO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-47°. There are four shorter (2.00 Å) and two longer (2.01 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Y and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms to form distorted ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, one Ti, and one Nb atom. F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Y atoms to form FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Nb₂ trigonal pyramid.
